verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a general workflow engine that can be triggered on record changes and can chain record operations, branches and custom code. That engine is a building block an ops user could use to construct routing. Nothing in the evidence documents lead assignment rules, owner routing or round-robin distribution as a product capability, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin
